Washington County Family Court Center

Address: 29 W Cherry Ave, Washington, PA 15301, United States
Google Maps Code: 5QC3+3H Washington, Pennsylvania, USA
Working Hours:

  • Monday – Friday: 8:30 AM – 7:30 PM
  • Saturday – Sunday: Closed
    Phone: +1 724-228-6999
    Website: www.washingtoncourts.us

Introduction

The Washington County Family Court Center is a crucial resource for families in need of legal assistance and support. Whether facing family disputes or requiring guidance on legal matters, the center provides essential services to help navigate these challenges efficiently and confidentially.

The center offers mediation, legal services, and counseling to assist families in resolving conflicts in a cost-effective and supportive manner.

History of the Washington County Family Court Center

The Washington County Family Court Center was established to create a supportive, non-adversarial environment for families. Over the years, it has served as a vital institution in the community, continually evolving to meet the legal and emotional needs of families.

Services Offered

1. Mediation and Conflict Resolution

  • Facilitates non-adversarial dispute resolution
  • Helps families reach mutually beneficial agreements without lengthy court proceedings

2. Legal Services

  • Assistance with divorce, child custody, and support matters
  • Legal counsel for navigating family law procedures

3. Counseling and Support Services

  • Emotional and psychological support for families facing legal challenges
  • Individual counseling and support groups

Court Process and Procedures

Types of Cases Handled

  • Divorce
  • Child custody and support
  • Domestic disputes

Roles in the Court Process

  • Judges: Oversee cases and render decisions
  • Mediators: Assist in resolving disputes amicably
  • Legal Counsels: Provide legal representation and guidance

Steps in the Court Process

  1. Filing a petition or complaint
  2. Mediation or preliminary hearings
  3. Court appearances and evidence presentation
  4. Resolution and court decision

Benefits of Using the Washington County Family Court Center

  • Cost-effective solutions: Avoids expensive legal battles
  • Confidential setting: Ensures privacy in sensitive matters
  • Comprehensive support: Legal, emotional, and informational assistance

Access to Resources and Information

1. Online Resources

  • Legal guides and forms available on the website

2. Library Services

  • Books and articles on family law

3. Referral Services

  • Connections to external support services

Additional Information

Washington County Family Court Judge

  • Judges oversee cases and ensure fair legal proceedings.

  • Schedule of upcoming hearings and mediations, accessible online.

Washington County Family Court Records

  • Court records, including case filings and decisions, can be accessed through official channels.

Washington County Family Law Assistance Program

  • Offers legal support to eligible families based on income and residency requirements.

Conclusion

The Washington County Family Court Center is dedicated to providing families with the necessary legal and emotional support. Whether dealing with divorce, custody, or mediation, the center ensures efficient, confidential, and cost-effective resolution of family disputes.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What types of cases does the Family Court Center handle?

It manages cases related to divorce, child custody, child support, and other family disputes.

Is it mandatory to use the Family Court Center?

No, but it provides a supportive, cost-effective alternative to traditional court proceedings.

How do I schedule a mediation session?

Call +1 724-228-6999 or use the online contact form.

What is the cost of services?

Costs vary based on services required. Contact the center for details.
